title: Hamster wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="30" ry="26" fill="#E8A96B"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="20" ry="18" fill="#F5D6A8"/>
  <!-- left ear -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="42" rx="10" ry="9" fill="#E8A96B"/>
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="42" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#F7B7C8"/>
  <!-- right ear -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="42" rx="10" ry="9" fill="#E8A96B"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="42" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#F7B7C8"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="26" ry="22" fill="#F2C48A"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="58" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#F7A8B8"/>
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="58" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#F7A8B8"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="49" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#4A3728"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="49" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#4A3728"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="47" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="47" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="56" rx="3" ry="2.5" fill="#D97B8A"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M47 60 Q50 63 53 60" stroke="#B86A4A" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- whiskers left -->
  <line x1="20" y1="54" x2="33" y2="56" stroke="#C99A6B" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="19" y1="60" x2="33" y2="60" stroke="#C99A6B" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- whiskers right -->
  <line x1="80" y1="54" x2="67" y2="56" stroke="#C99A6B" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="81" y1="60" x2="67" y2="60" stroke="#C99A6B" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points="50,12 36,38 64,38" fill="#FF5C8A"/>
  <polygon points="50,12 44,26 56,26" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <polygon points="50,12 47,20 53,20" fill="#5CD6FF"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="11" r="4" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <!-- hat stripe -->
  <path d="M40 32 L60 32" stroke="#5CD6FF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="82" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#F2C48A"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="82" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#F2C48A"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="92" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#E8A96B"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="92" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#E8A96B"/>
</svg>
